records.body:
## 为什么需要此修订

2026-11-13 综合审计对 main `cb17211653fde30aa50e0e9848798a6a5b3b3f12` 的裁决为 B。关键 P1 是现行宪章、准入规则和执行模板仍承载较强的普遍主张，而当前著作、数学合同及条件证明已明确收窄。仅更新摘要不能解除旧章程和 domains 消费者继承的义务。

## 本 PR 实际改变什么

- 通过既有 Class A RFC 和架构决议，协调 Constitution、Canonical Claims、Glossary、Method 四份现行文件；保留 12 个条目 ID、顺序和字段结构。
- 分开客体准入与现实存在、六种身份角色、两种 Ω、定性 Π/Φ 与条件数值表示、条件 GOD/GOA、功能与规范；修改实际模板，并明确六份旧 charter 及 domains 历史记录的继承范围。
- 将 P-CTL-01 来源矩阵的折扣条件从 `0≤β<1` 改为实际类型、冻结正文及现行正文一致的 `0<β<1`；这是唯一数学矩阵勘误。
- 更新七个当前入口；补齐贡献与证据边界、反例验收和交叉质询记录。两份原审计文件按原字节保存，历史 B 不倒写成 A。

主审已在作者的整改授权下采用内容，**以本 PR 正常合入 main 为生效事件**。采用后裁决为 **A：当前准确声明范围内达到合理闭合，冻结 Core 并停止自动扩张**。依据是已修复的真实 P1 和既有条件成果，不是新增证明数量或多数投票。

## 实际审查与验证

- 恰好三个原生子智能体：A 起草哲学/治理，B 核查数学/证据，C 独立对抗性验收；交叉审查后主审独立裁决。它们不是三位外部人类同行。
- 当前候选通过仓库未修改的 `validate_compression_research.py`：37 个路径、实际 6 个远端分支快照；基准及候选政策均读取实际 Git 对象。
- 最终内容检查通过：修改范围、12 条注册结构、436 个相对链接、3 个锚点、来源矩阵单行精确差异、历史文件哈希。
- C 实际重放 10 类精确有限反模型，输出与原审计一致；此为 Python 精确计算，**不是 Lean 检查**。
- 30 个 CSX、106 个 P-ID、两个互不相交的 163 声明集合分别计算，未混同清单。
- 原生产 Lean、工具链、Mathlib、冻结合同、书籍和物理内容未改变。远端发布树 `339b3e216d4c036bdd30a87b9653475a88646dde` 与通过检查的本地最终树完全相同。
- 新修订通过空白检查；完整 diff 的三项空白提示仅来自两份字节保全的历史报告，已在验证记录具名披露。

## 保留的限制与停止规则

**D3 新 Lean 执行仍未进行。** Mac 离线、当前环境无固定运行时；历史证明按当前源和依赖身份绑定复用为 E2，未宣称新的内核 PASS。经验支持仍 UNVERIFIED，全球优先权和外部同行认可仍未定。原 D5/D9 默认扩张停止，D6–D8 属可选研究或应用，D10 已完成端口不重开。

真实反例、接口消费者缺口、定义冲突、相关执行失败或证据错配可以重开具体义务；旧 OPEN 字样和可继续增加证明数量不构成重开理由。

## 审阅入口

- [结案与冻结裁决](https://github.com/MurphyHoops/UEOT/blob/40509e17d0a1d38a4e3ee47fadca0cff4759479c/research/audits/core-closure-2026-11-13/README.md)
- [架构决议](https://github.com/MurphyHoops/UEOT/blob/40509e17d0a1d38a4e3ee47fadca0cff4759479c/council/resolutions/20261113-core-claim-scope-reconciliation.md)
- [原完整审计（B，字节保全）](https://github.com/MurphyHoops/UEOT/blob/40509e17d0a1d38a4e3ee47fadca0cff4759479c/research/audits/core-closure-2026-11-13/prior-review/UEOT_CORE_COMPREHENSIVE_THEORY_AUDIT_2026-11-13.md)
- [数学证据与贡献](https://github.com/MurphyHoops/UEOT/blob/40509e17d0a1d38a4e3ee47fadca0cff4759479c/research/audits/core-closure-2026-11-13/MATHEMATICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_CONTRIBUTION.md)
- [本轮交叉质询](https://github.com/MurphyHoops/UEOT/blob/40509e17d0a1d38a4e3ee47fadca0cff4759479c/research/audits/core-closure-2026-11-13/CROSS_REVIEW_AND_ADJUDICATION.md)
- [验证及内容清单](https://github.com/MurphyHoops/UEOT/blob/40509e17d0a1d38a4e3ee47fadca0cff4759479c/research/audits/core-closure-2026-11-13/VALIDATION.json)

Refs #302, #146。二者继续作为长期历史索引，合并后只更新顶部恢复入口，不删除正文或自动激活旧任务。

## 已观察的集成与结案事件（2026-11-13 UTC）

- PR 于 `2026-11-13T08:54:41Z` 正常合并；回读 main 为 `6dd6a3bc13e26f41eddc10ee4d2f39fa1c8ab3d4`，树为 `339b3e216d4c036bdd30a87b9653475a88646dde`，与最终验收候选整树一致。Class A 决议及当前范围 A 冻结现已生效。
- #302、#146 顶部恢复入口已实际更新并回读。各只增加 240 字符前缀；原 63,701 / 65,172 字符正文分别作为完整原样后缀保存，两条 Issue 保持开放作为长期索引。
- 仓库自动触发的 Codex code review 已完成，记录针对 `40509e1` 无 findings；它不计为三名原生研究子智能体之一，也不作为新的数学或人类同行评审证据。
- **操作尾项：远端 `ops/core-audit-closure-20261113` 尚未删除。** 当前 GitHub 连接器没有删除分支接口；本地浏览器未连接，云端 GitHub 页面处于未登录状态。清理尚未执行，不记为完成；合并 PR 与 commit 已是正式档案，不再在该工作分支继续研究。
- 上述集成事实没有改变 D3 未执行、经验 UNVERIFIED、全球优先权未定的记录。

## 后继事实：2026-11-13 10:02 UTC

以上集成记录保留其当时状态。Local Mac 通道随后实际恢复可用：本 PR 的旧工作分支 `ops/core-audit-closure-20261113` 已在核对 merged/head 后于 09:07 UTC 删除，退休回执保存在后继证据包。

[D3 后继 PR #462](https://github.com/MurphyHoops/UEOT/pull/462) 已正常合并，合并提交为 `ab4862db08bae9333f422f7bdbba490f8c1ce0df`。实际执行源仍是本 PR 的 `6dd6a3b`，没有把后继文档提交倒写成执行源。15 个选定源文件重编译成功，44 项类型／公理查询实际执行（37 在新编译模块，7 在复用模块），12 项结构／定义打印完成；各失败 wrapper 原回执保全。主审与原三名 AI 子智能体的交叉审查接受 D3 在既定定向范围内完成，非全库干净重建。有限 A 冻结继续有效，经验 UNVERIFIED、规范理由和优先权边界不变。

[完整后继报告与证据](https://github.com/MurphyHoops/UEOT/blob/ab4862db08bae9333f422f7bdbba490f8c1ce0df/research/audits/core-closure-2026-11-13/d3-reproduction-2026-11-13/README.md)。#462 本轮工作分支也已在合并核对后删除；#302、#146 的恢复前缀已更新，原历史正文逐字保留。

records.body:
## Why

PR #461 adopted the bounded Core remediation and freeze decision, while D3 still lacked a fresh fixed-version execution. The Mac Local channel is now usable. This PR records the completed targeted execution and its independent review, without reopening Core development.

## Changes and conclusion

- Add one successor evidence package under `research/audits/core-closure-2026-11-13/d3-reproduction-2026-11-13/` and one CURRENT row.
- Record 15 successfully recompiled Lean source files (13 implementation modules, the public UEOT entry, and the growth document consumer), 44 fresh type/axiom queries, and 12 definition/structure prints.
- Distinguish 37 queried declarations in recompiled modules from 7 in reused modules; 42 declarations use only standard logical axioms and 2 retain the precisely disclosed native calculation dependencies.
- Preserve all three failed wrapper receipts and raw output. Successful individual Lean commands, post-execution checks, exact source readback and independent interpretation support the successor acceptance; no failed receipt is relabeled PASS.
- Accept **D3 as completed within the declared targeted scope**. The limited **A freeze adopted in #461 remains effective**; no additional Core proof or definition change is required by this result.

## Exact identity and validation

Executed source: `6dd6a3bc13e26f41eddc10ee4d2f39fa1c8ab3d4`; Lean 4.33.1; Mathlib `0df444a360eaa60ab8c11dca51a86af692955474`.

Remote head: `871682ae15a34bf345fbbe95492006c009985f66`.
Exact content tree: `c921e8ada008474c0cbf402ba5cca45b9cf41427`, equal to the independently reviewed local candidate tree (local commit `6746afd2e4ce864843997ca60f6256f1053dbe55`).

- 1,055 source/config Git blobs verified before/after; all nine locked dependency revisions verified.
- 30 fresh module artifacts and 63 corresponding old cache artifacts checked after the probe; 35 Lean command logs independently rehashed.
- 57 original payloads preserved. Only the large cache mirror manifest is stored as gzip; decompression recovers the exact original bytes.
- Root package validation: `PASS_TARGETED_D3_ACCEPTED`; unchanged governance validator: PASS. Authored text passes whitespace checks. Seventeen diagnostics are explicitly preserved in original logs/probes/diff evidence rather than editing executed bytes.
- A reviewed interpretation and final text; B reviewed all 44 declarations/types/axioms and the mathematical endpoints; C independently checked evidence provenance/axiom literals and accepted the targeted execution. C's final publication-boundary review confirmed the exact tree, 102 changed files, 57 preserved payloads, report identities and unchanged production/governance sources. These are three separate AI review contexts, not external human peer review.

## Scope and limits

The complete diff is 101 added evidence-package files plus one CURRENT row. Production Lean, frozen definitions/contracts/books, dependency locks, earlier audits and physics/GI work remain unchanged.

This is **not a full clean build**. Other dependencies reuse matched caches; the two native numerical computations were not freshly rerun. Pretty-printed type elisions are supplemented by exact fixed-source declarations. Empirical applicability, normative justification, originality priority and external academic acceptance are not established by these Lean runs.

Report: [D3 successor audit](https://github.com/MurphyHoops/UEOT/blob/ab4862db08bae9333f422f7bdbba490f8c1ce0df/research/audits/core-closure-2026-11-13/d3-reproduction-2026-11-13/README.md).

Relates to #461, #302 and #146. Recovery issues remain open. Actual merge and branch retirement will be recorded only after observed events.


## Observed integration — 2026-11-13 10:02 UTC

- Normal merge completed at 10:01:38 UTC: `ab4862db08bae9333f422f7bdbba490f8c1ce0df`; main was read back at that exact commit.
- The merged tree is `c921e8ada008474c0cbf402ba5cca45b9cf41427`, identical to the independently reviewed candidate. All 102 remote diff paths/statuses/blob IDs match the local candidate manifest; CURRENT has exactly one added row and no deletion.
- The final premerge GitHub status endpoint had zero status contexts and zero check runs. No cloud CI success is claimed; execution and review evidence are documented in the package.
- At 10:02:19 UTC, Mac `gh` verified the merged PR, exact head and main, deleted only `ops/core-audit-reproduction-20261113`, and read back its absence. Other listed remote branches were unchanged. The prior #461 branch had already been retired; its receipt remains in this package.
- #302 and #146 remain open as recovery indexes. Their known 240-character current prefix was replaced with a 304-character successor prefix; all 63,701 / 65,172 original body characters remain exact suffixes.
- Adoption does not change the executed source `6dd6a3bc13e26f41eddc10ee4d2f39fa1c8ab3d4`. D3 is completed within scope; the limited A Core freeze remains effective. Stop repeated execution absent a new source change, concrete counterexample, real consumer or evidence mismatch.
